new.meaning: to be ambiguous, to be unclear (to — <bdi>عَلَى</bdi>)

new.extra: to be ambiguous, to be unclear · Form VIII · its ism fāʿil is in the ḥadīth: <bdi>وَبَيْنَهُمَا أُمُورٌ مُشْتَبِهَاتٌ</bdi>, and between them are ambiguous matters · same root as <bdi>شُبْهَة</bdi>, a doubtful matter (pl. <bdi>شُبُهَات</bdi>)

new.meaning: to guard against, to beware of — of Allah, to be mindful of Him

new.extra: to guard against, to beware of · Form VIII (assimilated + defective) · from <bdi>و‑ق‑ي</bdi>: the <bdi>و</bdi> becomes <bdi>ت</bdi> and merges with the <bdi>ت</bdi> of Form VIII · <bdi>فَمَنِ اتَّقَى الشُّبُهَاتِ</bdi>, so whoever guards against the doubtful matters

new.meaning: to seek to be clear (of blame or doubt) — to make sure one is free of something

new.extra: to seek to be clear · Form X (hamzated) · <bdi>فَقَدِ اسْتَبْرَأَ لِدِينِهِ وَعِرْضِهِ</bdi>, he has kept his religion and his honour clear · in fiqh, <bdi>اِسْتِبْرَاء</bdi> is making sure no urine remains after relieving oneself

new.meaning: to graze (livestock), to pasture them — also, to look after, to care for

new.extra: to graze · Form I (defective) · your yar'ee is <bdi>يَرْعَى</bdi> (yarʿā): <bdi>ع</bdi> is a throat letter, and a <bdi>فَعَلَ</bdi> verb with one in the middle or last place usually takes fatḥah in the muḍāriʿ, like <bdi>فَتَحَ يَفْتَحُ</bdi> · also <bdi>رِعَايَة</bdi>, care

new.meaning: to be about to, to be on the verge of

new.extra: to be about to · Form IV (assimilated) · only its māḍī and muḍāriʿ are in use · one of the verbs of nearness (<bdi>أَفْعَال المُقَارَبَة</bdi>): its khabar is a muḍāriʿ, nearly always with <bdi>أَنْ</bdi>, as in <bdi>يُوشِكُ أَنْ يَرْتَعَ فِيهِ</bdi>, he is about to graze in it

new.meaning: to roam and graze at will — to enjoy oneself freely

new.extra: to roam and graze at will · Form I · bāb <bdi>فَتَحَ يَفْتَحُ</bdi> · also <bdi>رُتُوع</bdi> · <bdi>يَرْتَعْ وَيَلْعَبْ</bdi>, that he may enjoy himself and play (12:12)

new.meaning: to go bad, to be corrupt — in fiqh, of a prayer or fast: to be invalidated

new.extra: to go bad, to be corrupt · Form I · bāb <bdi>نَصَرَ يَنْصُرُ</bdi> · the opposite of <bdi>صَلَحَ</bdi> (voc-176) · <bdi>وَإِذَا فَسَدَتْ فَسَدَ الجَسَدُ كُلُّهُ</bdi>, and when it is corrupt, the whole body is corrupt
